name: The Hermit
summary: Elaine Carevin in Darkshire sends you to check on Abercrombie, an elderly recluse who has not come to town for provisions. He lives in a rickety shack at the edge of Raven Hill Cemetery.

sections.title: A Neighborly Check-In
sections.body: Elaine Carevin remembers an old man who came to Darkshire for provisions, then stopped appearing. With danger on Duskwood’s roads, she asks you to visit his shack by Raven Hill Cemetery and see whether he is safe.

sections.title: The Recluse of Raven Hill
sections.body: At the shack, you find Abercrombie alive. He chuckles at the Carevins’ concern and says age and the monsters in the woods have kept him from town. Glad to have an able traveler at his door, he quickly asks for help with a few errands.

faq.answer: Elaine Carevin, who lives in Darkshire, asks you to check on an old hermit who once came to town for supplies.
Abercrombie lives in a wooden shack at the northern edge of Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood.

faq.q: Why was Elaine Carevin worried about him?
aliases: what happened to the old man
faq.answer: Abercrombie used to visit Darkshire for supplies, but stopped coming. With beasts and undead on the roads, Elaine feared he had died.

faq.q: Is Abercrombie actually in danger when you find him?
faq.answer: No. Abercrombie is alive when you reach his shack. He says age and dangerous roads made travel too burdensome.

faq.q: Why does someone choose to live right next to Raven Hill Cemetery?
aliases: why is the hermit near graves
faq.answer: Abercrombie says he prefers the seclusion. His home beside one of the Eastern Kingdoms’ most necromantically corrupted graveyards unsettles many travelers.

faq.q: What does Abercrombie ask for once you reach him?
faq.answer: Abercrombie quickly asks you to help with errands and tasks around the woods.

angles.text: The Night Watch struggles to protect the roads between Darkshire and Raven Hill, leaving recluses like Abercrombie cut off from town’s safety.
As a human, you know the Carevin family’s neighborly ties. They look out for Duskwood’s elders even as shadow falls over the region.
